question: With the forward preference fixed to Lt, does switching the input VJP preference change BF16 error and event timing?
inputs: Three original observed Qwen shapes/strides from previous evidence; same locked synthetic BF16 components within each card.
design: One pilot node, eight DCUs. One independent measurement process per physical DCU; ABBA or BAAB per rank. Two warmup and 256 measured calls per block. GPU FP32 rounded to BF16 used as a component reference. Keep 0.0625 maximum absolute threshold. Include all runtime and numerical failures.
timing_scope: VJP event interval includes the backend preference switch and dispatch gap; records enclosing time only. Driver samples are separate.
qualification: API preference readback only; kernel identity and model numerical acceptance remain unverified.
